preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 100000 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [[tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)] for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n - 1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges) for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [[tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)] for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]]))
preconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) in a test case has vertices a and b between 1 and n inclusive, and a is not equal to b.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(k, int) and k >= 0 for k in [int(output.split()[0]) for output in stdout.split('\n') if output])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of the output contains a single integer k, the minimum number of operations required to obtain a bamboo, which is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(len(operations) == k for k, operations in zip([int(output.split()[0]) for output in stdout.split('\n') if output], [output.split()[1:] for output in stdout.split('\n') if len(output.split()) > 1]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of operations listed in the output matches the value of k.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and int(x) != int(y) for x, y in zip(operations[::2], operations[1::2])) for k, n, operations in zip([int(output.split()[0]) for output in stdout.split('\n') if output], [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [output.split()[1:] for output in stdout.split('\n') if len(output.split()) > 1]))
postconditions.description: Each operation (x, y) in the output has vertices x and y between 1 and n inclusive, and x is not equal to y.
